$comment: Canonical table policy for the pear-snapshot-v2 export/import format. Every PUBLIC module table must appear in exactly one of `include` or `exclude` — enforced from the TypeScript side (pear/web/src/lib/pearExport.test.ts, against generated bindings) and the Rust side (pear/server/spacetimedb/src/import/pear_v2.rs tests, against the importer dispatch table). Adding a module table without updating this file fails CI on both sides. Private tables are not in client bindings and are intentionally outside this policy (documented in docs/RUNBOOKS/restore-workspace.md).

exclude.ai_extension_runtime: Caller-scoped runtime view containing MCP endpoints and credentials. It is derived from installed extension configuration and must never be exported.
exclude.ai_user_config: Contains plaintext provider API keys and worker tokens. Never exported. Import restores stub configs from ai_user_profile rows (same behavior as v1); operators reconfigure keys post-restore.
exclude.automation_primitive: Seeded catalog of available primitives keyed by name (seed_automation_primitives_inner); module-defined, not user data.
exclude.bridge_approval: Transient mid-turn permission prompts raised by ACP harness agents; deleted by the terminal complete/reject reducers alongside the command's chunks. A prompt only means anything while the turn that raised it is still blocked, so restoring one would show live buttons for work that ended long ago.
exclude.bridge_command_chunk: Transient streaming output for in-flight bridge commands; deleted by the terminal complete/reject reducers. The durable record is bridge_command_result.
exclude.extension_runtime_health: Transient worker handshake and tool-discovery status. It is re-created by AI workers after a restore.
exclude.id_counter: Module-managed id allocator. import_v2_commit deletes all counter rows so the next allocation re-seeds from post-import max(id) (see id_counters.rs).
exclude.migration_state: Module-managed migration bookkeeping; owned by the module version that publishes, never restored.
exclude.module_install_meta: Module-managed publisher-identity record; re-created by init on the restore target.
exclude.my_extension_permissions: Caller-scoped #[view] projection over the private extension_permission table for the Settings UI; derived per-sender at read time, nothing to export or restore.
exclude.notion_import_job: Transient background-import queue (carries Notion token ciphertexts, blanked on completion); jobs are meaningless on a restore target and must never ride along in backups.
exclude.sensor_registry: Fully seeded at init (seed_sensor_registry_inner); findings reference sensors by string (sensor_kind, code), never by id, so re-seeded rows are equivalent.

import_row_guards.harness_template: Skip rows with source == Builtin (re-seeded by init; unique external_id would collide).
import_row_guards.extension_manifest: Skip rows with extension_type == Builtin (seeded by seed_builtin_extensions_inner; ids collide with counter-allocated seeds).
import_row_guards.installed_extension: Skip rows whose manifest_id refers to a skipped Builtin manifest (the seed creates its own installed row).
import_row_guards.component_type_definition: Skip rows with is_builtin == true (re-seeded by init; component_node references types by string, so id drift is harmless).
